lines.say: My client stopped coming in. So I moved my shop into his living room.
caps: So I moved my shop into his living room.

lines.say: I put the chair on a monster truck. Drove it through his front wall.
His wife brought coffee. His goat got a fade. Then forty neighbors lined up.
Comment KEEP if you've ever gone this far for one client.
caps: gone this far for one client.

lines.say: Then a cop showed up. To arrest me. He sat down, and asked for a taper.
Then Terrence walks in with groceries. His living room is a barbershop.
caps: His living room is a barbershop.

lines.say: He goes, bro. I meant to book. Then it was week eight, and it got weird.
A truck. A wall. A goat. Because he needed one text.
caps: A truck. A wall. A goat.

lines.say: So now I use Message Health. It spots who's gone quiet and texts them before it gets weird.
caps: It texts them *before it gets weird.*
